## Change summary

Describe the smallest intended public-site change.

## Public-release safety

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, private keys, OAuth credentials, recovery codes, private Drive links, private chat exports, medical/financial records, unpublished Luna Bank material, or other non-public personal/project data are included.
- [ ] Third-party material preserves its original authorship, provenance, independence, and reuse/permission boundaries.
- [ ] Community Trigon material remains separate from UBT / Luna•Prime•Protocol project-originated R&D.
- [ ] Public claims stay within the evidence actually released and do not turn exploratory, ambiguous, failed, null, blocked, or unreplicated results into confirmation.
- [ ] Branding uses the exact form **Luna•Prime•Protocol** where that brand is intended.
- [ ] Links, contact routes, and public metadata were checked for accidental private or stale targets.
- [ ] The final diff was reviewed for unexpected files, generated artifacts, archives, credentials, or personal data.

## Verification

State what was actually checked or run. Use explicit labels such as PASS, FAIL, NOT RUN, PARTIAL, or UNAVAILABLE.

## Reversibility

Explain how this change can be reverted or isolated if it causes a problem.
